subject: Discovery recap + proposal: rotating deep-dive time windows
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara@heliohealth.com>, James O'Neill <james@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposal: rotating deep-dive time windows

Hi Sara, James — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and an ask to lock the technical deep-dive: 

Recap (30 min discovery)
- Primary goals: validate inference latency targets for batch workloads, confirm data residency constraints, discuss integration surface for prefix/KV caching.
- Key stakeholders: James (CTO) for infra, Sara (Head of Data) for compliance and SLOs, engineering leads for deep-dive.
- Current constraints: mixed US/EU/APAC stakeholders, HelioHealth asked for a recurring demo window that rotates to be fair to global teams.

Proposal (next step) — rotating weekly deep-dive slots
- We propose a repeating 1-hour technical session that rotates across three time bands so each region gets a convenient window:
  * US-friendly: 09:00–10:00 PT (16:00–17:00 UTC)
  * EU-friendly: 16:00–17:00 CET (15:00–16:00 UTC)
  * APAC-friendly: 19:00–20:00 HKT (11:00–12:00 UTC)
- Rotation cadence: week-by-week cycle (Week A: US, Week B: EU, Week C: APAC) — we can adjust to every-other-week if you prefer lighter cadence.

Can you confirm which of these bands works best for your teams? I attached a simple time matrix with specific date options for the first three cycles so we can pin the calendar. Once you confirm, we'll assign Redwood leads and send invites with the rotating recurrence.

Attachments: discovery_notes.pdf (summary), time_matrix_proposal.csv (date options)

Thanks — looking forward to locking the first session.

Best,
Dev Patel
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

From: Sara Kim <sara@heliohealth.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: James O'Neill <james@heliohealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 21:46:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposal: rotating deep-dive time windows

Hi Dev — thanks for the clear recap. James and I reviewed the slots with the infra and data teams. A couple notes: 

- APAC preference: our Melbourne and Singapore engineers prefer an earlier APAC-friendly window (07:30–08:30 SGT) rather than 19:00 HKT — the late evening slot is hard for on-call folks. Could we shift the APAC band to 23:30–00:30 UTC (07:30–08:30 SGT)?
- Rotation cadence: bi-weekly rotation (every 2 weeks) is preferable — gives time to follow up on action items between sessions.
- For the first 3 cycles we can do these dates:
  * Option 1 (start week): Tue, 1 Jul 2025 — prefer EU band for that week
  * Option 2: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 — US band
  * Option 3: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 — APAC band (morning SGT)

If you can update the matrix and send a proposed recurring invite (bi-weekly, rotating), we'll lock it. Also note: James asked that the deep-dive include a short (10–15m) segment on how Redwood handles graceful fallback to cheaper model variants — that'll help procurement scope cost estimates.

Thanks,
Sara
Head of Data | HelioHealth
sara@heliohealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: internal: taking EU week for rotation (1 Jul)

Quick internal note — I'll own the EU-friendly week (Tue, 1 Jul) and lead the demo for that slot. Ben, can you take the US-friendly slot (Thu, 10 Jul)? Dev — please confirm the APAC-friendly morning for Wed, 23 Jul and I'll coordinate slides and invites.

Also adding a brief tech checklist for the call:
- Pre-upload small sample dataset (S3 link)
- Network diagram + allowed IPs for a short connectivity test (if they want)
- 10–15 min cost/fallback segment as Sara requested

Marissa
Sr Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara@heliohealth.com>, James O'Neill <james@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposal: rotating deep-dive time windows

Hi Sara, James — thanks for the quick reply and the APAC preference. We've updated the matrix to reflect the earlier APAC band (07:30–08:30 SGT / 23:30–00:30 UTC). Proposed schedule (bi-weekly rotating recurrence):

- Tue, 1 Jul 2025 — EU-friendly (16:00–17:00 CET) — Marissa lead
- Thu, 10 Jul 2025 — US-friendly (09:00–10:00 PT) — Ben lead
- Wed, 23 Jul 2025 — APAC-friendly (07:30–08:30 SGT) — Dev lead

I've attached an updated time matrix and created a shared calendar view here: https://calendar.redwood.ai/shared/helio-time-matrix-9f2b. If that looks good, I'll send the bi-weekly invite that rotates between those three time bands (we'll use a single recurring series that moves by week).

Prep items for you to drop before the first session:
- Sample dataset link (S3) or a small CSV
- Any blocked IPs for a connectivity test
- A short list of cost/throughput targets (tokens/s, percentile latency targets) — James mentioned procurement will want that for the TCO estimate

Would you like the invites to include a short agenda and the 10–15 min fallback/cost segment as a fixed item?

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
(attachment: time_matrix_proposal.csv)
From: James O'Neill <james@heliohealth.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Kim <sara@heliohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 09:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposal: rotating deep-dive time windows

Thanks — that schedule works for us. Please send the recurring invite and include a short tech-run checklist in the invite body so our infra team can prepare. Also:

- Can you drop a 1–2 page tech brief ahead of the first session that covers: 1) prefix/KV cache behavior during warmup; 2) model variant fallback logic and expected latency delta; 3) basic quantization/throughput tradeoffs?
- We use Okta SSO — will the meeting materials or demo require any SSO access? If so, we should coordinate early.

Once you share the calendar series I will send invites to the wider infra audience on our side. Looking forward to the run-through.

Best,
James O'Neill
CTO | HelioHealth
james@heliohealth.com
(attachment requested: technical-onepager.pdf)
